claims.quote: "On this page" marks the section a link was followed to. For every one of the page's 273 section links it used to mark the section before, or none for a document's first section: a link puts a heading 168 pixels below the top of the window, the page's scroll padding and the heading's scroll margin together, and a heading counted as reached only above 140. A section now counts as reached where a link puts its heading, read from the stylesheet. At the end of a page the last section is the one being read, where its heading could never get high enough to be marked, as in 29 of the 39 documents in a window 800 pixels tall. A section a link was followed to stays marked for as long as the page stays where the link left it, also when the page is too short to bring its heading up.
